_meta.description: Single source of truth for US state vehicle purchase fees, taxes, and doc-fee caps. Consumed by otd_calculator.py and render_state_data.py. Each record's `verified` flag indicates whether the values have been web-confirmed in Round 2; only MD is ground-truth verified in Round 1.
_meta.seed_source: skills/orchestrator/scripts/otd_calculator.py inline dicts + skills/orchestrator/references/state_fees.md All-State Summary Table & detail stubs

field_notes.tax_state: State-level base sales/excise rate as decimal fraction (e.g. 0.06625 = 6.625%). For non-sales-tax mechanisms (TAVT, HUT, excise) this is the headline rate used by the OTD calculator.
field_notes.tax_local_typ: Typical local stacking range as human-readable string; informational only, calculator takes --local at runtime.
field_notes.tax_mechanism: sales_tax | tavt | hut | excise_weight | doc_fee_in_lieu | sut | imf — describes how the headline tax behaves.
field_notes.doc_cap: Statutory doc-fee cap as a number, or null if no statutory cap.
field_notes.detail_depth: full = has a dedicated detail stub; summary = only in summary table; stub = minimal.

states.tax_local_typ: +county 0.3-2.5% & city 0-4% at buyer locale (separate, lower automotive rates; combined typ. ~2.3-5%, occasionally higher)
states.doc_cap_history: No statutory cap; doc fee is dealer-set and TAXABLE at the automotive rate; AL avg ~$485

states.tax_local_typ: 0% state sales tax; borough/city local sales tax 0-7.5% (Anchorage/Fairbanks 0%, Juneau 5%), many jurisdictions cap tax per transaction
states.doc_cap_history: No statutory cap; typical industry doc fee ~$80
does_not_have: statewide trade-in tax credit rule (local ordinances govern)

states.tax_local_typ: county+city stacking, combined typ 7.7%, up to 11.2%
states.doc_cap_history: No statutory dollar cap; A.R.S. requires only that fees be reasonable. Typical AZ doc fee $395-499 (median ~$499), some dealers $500-700.
does_not_have: tax on manufacturer rebates removed from base (rebates are NOT deducted)

states.tax_local_typ: 1-5% (combined typ ~9.5-11.5%)
states.doc_cap_history: No statutory doc-fee cap; typical industry range $110-395. A '$125 cap' figure circulates on calculator sites but is NOT supported by statute or DFA.

states.tax_local_typ: 0.10-2.00% district tax (combined 7.75-10.75% at buyer ZIP)
states.doc_cap_statute: CA Vehicle Code §§ 11713.1(g) & 4456.5 (DMV business-partner dealers; $70 for non-partner dealers); itemization governed by Civ. Code § 2982 (ASFA)
states.doc_cap_history: $45 -> $55 -> $80 (2012) -> $85 current; SB 791 (2025) to raise to lesser of 1% or $260 was VETOED by Gov. Newsom Oct 2025, so $85 cap stands
does_not_have: statewide local-rate stacking beyond district tax

states.tax_local_typ: county up to 5% + city/special district; Denver/Boulder ZIPs combined ~8.85%
states.doc_cap_history: No statutory cap. Often called 'dealer handling fee'. Typical $400-700; Denver-metro dealers commonly at high end.
does_not_have: trade-in tax on dealer sales (trade reduces taxable base; private sales do NOT)
rebate deduction (rebates/incentives are NOT deducted before tax)

states.tax_local_typ: 0% (no sales tax; document fee in lieu)
states.doc_cap_statute: No dealer doc fee cap (the 5.25% is a state title document fee, not a dealer doc fee)
states.doc_cap_history: State document (title) fee: 4.25% -> 5.25% effective 2025-10-01. This is the tax mechanism, distinct from any dealer processing fee, which DE does not cap.
does_not_have: trade-in tax credit mechanism (trade-in does reduce the 5.25% doc fee base, but there is no separate sales tax)

states.tax_local_typ: 0% (excise by weight class; 6-9% on first $40k MSRP, higher above)
0.5-2% county surtax on first $5k only
N/A (TAVT one-time, no traditional sales tax)
does_not_have: traditional sales tax on titled vehicles

states.tax_local_typ: 4.0% GET + 0.5% county surcharge on all 4 counties (Honolulu, Kauai, Maui, Hawaii) = 4.5%; dealer pass-on rate up to 4.712%
states.doc_cap_history: No statutory doc-fee cap identified (secondary-sourced)
does_not_have: trade-in tax credit (only dealer discounts reduce GET base)

states.tax_local_typ: 0% on vehicles (flat 6% state; no local add-on on motor vehicle sales)
states.doc_cap_history: No statutory doc fee cap; median ~$265-399, must be disclosed but not capped
does_not_have: local sales tax stacking on vehicles

states.doc_cap_statute: 625 ILCS 5/5-101.1 (CPI-linked, updated annually)
states.doc_cap_history: CPI-indexed annually; $347.26 figure is the 2025 value
does_not_have: per-tire fee on retail used sales

states.tax_local_typ: 0% (no local/county sales tax on vehicles)
states.doc_cap_statute: IC 9-32-13-7 (document preparation fee; $200 base, CPI-indexed annually)
states.doc_cap_history: $200 base (codified ~2017 from AG settlement) -> CPI-indexed: $237.51 (eff 2023-06-01) -> $251.05 (eff 2025-07-01, SOS Auto Dealer Services Division no-enforcement threshold).
does_not_have: rebate deduction (manufacturer rebates are NOT deducted; trade-in IS)

states.tax_local_typ: 0% (5% Fee for New Registration in lieu of sales tax; no local stacking)
states.doc_cap_statute: No statutory dealer doc fee cap
states.doc_cap_history: Never capped; doc fees set by dealers. Typical IA doc fee ~$135.
does_not_have: traditional sales tax (5% Fee for New Registration applies instead)

states.tax_local_typ: 0-4% (combined up to ~11.5%)
states.doc_cap_history: No statutory doc-fee cap; dealer-set, typical ~$285; doc fee is part of taxable gross receipts per KS-1526.

states.tax_local_typ: 0% (no local usage tax; 6% flat statewide)
states.doc_cap_statute: No statutory dealer doc fee cap
states.doc_cap_history: Never capped; doc fees set by dealers.
does_not_have: annual ad valorem replaced by usage tax (property tax still applies separately)

states.tax_local_typ: +4-7% parish/municipal (combined typ. ~9-10%, up to ~12.95% at high-rate ZIPs)
states.doc_cap_statute: La. R.S. 6:969.18(A)(2) (Motor Vehicle Sales Finance Act — documentation/compliance fee; CPI-indexed, max 3%/yr increase, published annually by LA Motor Vehicle Commission)
states.doc_cap_history: $35 (original) -> $200 -> $425 (2020, SB144) -> ~$436 (CPI-adjusted, effective 2025-07-04 per Acts 2025 No. 502)

states.doc_cap_statute: MD Transportation Code Ann. § 15-311.1

does_not_have: local sales tax stacking on vehicles

states.tax_local_typ: no general local sales tax on motor vehicles; some counties/cities levy a flat $20 vehicle excise tax per sale (not a %)
states.doc_cap_statute: Minn. Stat. § 168.27 subd. 31 (documentary/document administration fee — lesser of $350 or 10% of sale value; 10% prong only bites on vehicles <= $3,499)
states.doc_cap_history: $75 -> $125 (long-standing low cap, Minn. Stat. 168.27) -> $350 effective 2025-07-01 (HF1513 / 2025 session)
does_not_have: general local sales tax stacking on vehicles

states.tax_local_typ: 0% (3% trucks >10,000 lb GVW)
states.doc_cap_history: No statewide statutory doc-fee cap; dealer-set, typical ~$230.

states.tax_local_typ: county+city+special, 0-5.5% at buyer ZIP
states.doc_cap_statute: RSMo § 301.558 + 12 CSR 10-26.231 (administrative fee; $500 base, CPI-indexed annually)
states.doc_cap_history: $500 base (2021) -> $523.50 (2022) -> $565.38 (2023) -> $587.43 (2024) -> $604.47 (2025 licensure year, rule effective 2025-08-17). Dealer must remit 10% of fee to MV Tech Fund and charge a uniform declared fee to all retail buyers.
does_not_have: uncapped doc fee (capped at CPI-indexed max)
tax on trade-in value (trade reduces taxable base)

states.tax_local_typ: 0% state sales tax; counties may levy a county option tax (~0.3-0.5% of depreciated MSRP)
states.doc_cap_history: No statutory cap; typical industry doc fee ~$224
does_not_have: trade-in tax credit (moot: no sales tax)

states.tax_local_typ: 0-2% local (combined up to ~7.5%)
states.doc_cap_history: No statutory cap; typical dealer doc fee ~$280

states.doc_cap_statute: No statutory dealer doc fee cap
states.doc_cap_history: Never capped; doc fees set by dealers.

states.tax_local_typ: 0% state/local sales tax; municipal permit fee acts as a value-based tax ($18->$3 per $1,000 MSRP by age)
states.doc_cap_statute: NH RSA 261:171-a (state document fee: $25 title + $2 agent)
states.doc_cap_history: $27 cap applies ONLY to the state document/title fee; dealer 'administrative/documentary' fees are NOT capped (commonly $300-$495)
does_not_have: trade-in tax credit (moot: no sales tax)
statutory cap on dealer administrative fees
environmental impact fee on used vehicles

states.tax_local_typ: 0% (MVET is flat statewide 4%)
states.doc_cap_history: No statutory doc-fee cap; dealer transfer service fee is a separate GRT-taxable add-on, not part of MVET base.
does_not_have: traditional retail sales tax on vehicles (uses 4% MVET excise instead)

states.tax_local_typ: 0% (state excise only; no local on motor vehicles)
states.doc_cap_history: No statutory doc fee cap; 5% motor vehicle excise tax under NDCC ch. 57-40.3
does_not_have: traditional sales tax on motor vehicles
local sales tax stacking on vehicles

states.tax_local_typ: 0% (excise in lieu of sales tax; flat 3.25% statewide)
states.doc_cap_statute: No statutory cap (47 O.S. governs disclosure, not amount)
states.doc_cap_history: Never capped; ONMVC advertising rules require disclosure only. Typical OK doc fee ~$300-$785, avg ~$549.
does_not_have: traditional state/local sales tax on titled vehicles
local tax stacking on the excise

states.tax_local_typ: 0% local sales tax; 0.5% vehicle privilege tax on new dealer sales (2018+, <7,500 mi, never OR-titled); 0.5% use tax on out-of-state purchases
states.doc_cap_history: $115/$150 (pre-2023) -> $200/$250 (current): $200 if dealer does not use an integrator, $250 if it does

states.tax_local_typ: 1-2% (Philly +2% / Allegheny +1%)
N/A — IMF (5% of price, capped $500/vehicle) replaces state+local sales tax on titled vehicles
states.doc_cap_statute: Closing fee: S.C. Code Ann. § 37-2-307 — no hard dollar cap, but a dealer charging > $225 triggers a DOR reasonableness review; dealer must file annual notice + $10 filing fee
states.doc_cap_history: IMF cap: $300 (pre-2017 sales-tax cap) -> $500 IMF effective 2017-07-01 (S.C. Code § 56-3-627, 2017 Act 40). Closing-fee $225 review threshold set by 2023 amendment to § 37-2-307
does_not_have: traditional state/local sales tax on titled vehicles
general local sales-tax stacking on vehicles

states.tax_local_typ: 0% (4% motor vehicle excise in lieu of sales tax; no local stacking)
states.doc_cap_history: No statutory doc fee cap; typical ~$115. Doc fee is part of the 4% excise-taxable base
does_not_have: traditional sales tax on motor vehicles
local sales tax stacking on vehicles

states.tax_local_typ: local option 2.00-2.75% on first $1,600 (max ~$36) + 2.75% single-article on $1,600-$3,200 (max ~$44)
states.doc_cap_history: No statutory cap. T.C.A. § 55-17-114 authorizes the fee but bars representing it as a government charge. Typical TN doc fee ~$495-499.
does_not_have: uncapped local sales tax (local capped to first $1,600)
rebate deduction (rebates are NOT deducted before tax)

states.tax_local_typ: 0-1.75% local (combined max 8.00%); SPV floor on private-party
states.doc_cap_statute: Tex. Finance Code § 348.006(f); rule 7 TAC § 84.205 (OCCC) — presumed-reasonable amount, not a hard cap; fees above $225 require OCCC cost-justification filing
states.doc_cap_history: $150 (set 2016 by Finance Commission) -> $225 (effective 2024-07-11); not a statutory ceiling, OCCC safe-harbor

states.tax_local_typ: 1-3% (combined typ ~6.1-9.05%)
states.doc_cap_history: No statutory doc-fee cap (UT DMV confirms no limit); disclosure-only per Utah Admin Code R877-23V-14; dealer-set, typical $300-500.

states.tax_local_typ: 0-1% local
0% (5% privilege/sales tax on vehicles; WV uses 6% general but vehicle title privilege tax is 5%)
states.doc_cap_statute: WV Code 17A-6A-8a (DMV Dealer Advisory Board set cap) [PENDING heterogeneous re-verify: Codex could not confirm $575 source]
states.doc_cap_history: $499 -> $575 (effective 2024-07-01); CPI-indexed annually beginning 2025-07-01 per Dealer Advisory Board
does_not_have: local sales tax stacking on vehicles

states.tax_local_typ: +0.5% county (most counties); 0% in Waukesha/Winnebago; Milwaukee Co 0.9% + City of Milwaukee +2% (combined up to ~7.9% in Milwaukee city)
states.doc_cap_history: No statutory cap; doc fee (taxable) is dealer-set, WI avg ~$190; optional $99 service fee sometimes added
does_not_have: city-level vehicle sales tax outside Milwaukee

states.tax_local_typ: 4% state + 0-2% county (typical 5-6% combined; rate by buyer's county of residence)
states.doc_cap_history: No statutory cap; doc fee is itself taxable as part of sales price; typical $100-$495
does_not_have: value-credit on used private sales (taxed at FMV)
